title: A12 flags a semicolon inside an inline comment as code padding
symptom: For the line `const a = 1; // note ;`, `straySemicolonPadding` returns 1 and `buildReport` emits A12 with detail `1 space(s) before ;` and a hint to remove those spaces. The final semicolon and preceding space belong to the inline comment, not to a code token or alignment axis, so the alarm is false. The scratch inspection found the same helper is used by the stray-padding writer; its TypeScript preservation gate restores comment changes, so no lasting write from this example was demonstrated.

rootCause.summary: A12 initially considered inline-comment punctuation and routed non-TS/Python inputs through Python lexical assumptions; broad Python helper errors also hid alarms. Candidate v2 restricts A12 to TypeScript/Python, exposes non-classified helper failures, and batches candidate classification. Final checks and Opus fix-only review passed; the timing remains a single bounded sample, not a general performance guarantee.

requestedOutcome: Do not report or propose A12 padding changes for punctuation inside inline comments, while retaining existing A12 behavior for confirmed bare-code semicolon padding and preserving report output shape.
decisions: Treat the observation as an inaccurate alarm and proposal, not as a demonstrated lasting source mutation.
Use language-aware lexical context or conservatively omit uncertain cases; do not split source text on `//` without syntax awareness.

actions.description: Exclude inline-comment punctuation from A12 while retaining actual bare-code padding behavior and report shape.
Restrict A12 to TypeScript/Python, omit unverified JSON/YAML semantics, and batch candidate classification while preserving token checks.
Keep the 5,000-line/500-candidate timing as one bounded local sample only; do not state a general performance guarantee.
Complete the frozen candidate self-use audit and parser-required full check; both passed with the scope recorded in the linked evidence.
Complete the v2 frozen checks and required fixed-model Opus fix-only review before closure; both are now recorded as passed.

Make Python A12 helper failures observable or catch only the classified invalid-source condition; add focused coverage for failure visibility without expanding candidate detection; regression and review evidence are recorded for candidate v2.
